title: Harbor Trivy Scanner
description: Operational health, performance and capacity of one Harbor Trivy scanner installation. Security findings remain in Harbor.

list.name: cluster
list.label: Cluster
list.description: One cluster. Supply a unique cluster scrape label; external labels are only usable if present in this query datasource.

list.name: namespace
list.label: Namespace
list.description: One namespace in the selected cluster.

list.name: scanner
list.label: Scanner
list.description: One stable scanner service/deployment; its replicas are aggregated.

list.name: redis_service
list.label: Redis service (optional)
list.description: Exporter service label for the Redis instance used by this scanner. Blank disables its memory panel; shared Redis includes other workloads.

list.name: scanner_pods
list.description: Internal expansion of only the selected scanner pods; no wildcard allValue.

panels.title: Reachable replicas
panels.description: Prometheus scrape availability. A healthy endpoint does not prove scans complete.

panels.title: Instrumented replicas
panels.description: Zero with reachable targets means this adapter version lacks operational metrics. If selectors are empty, configure cluster/namespace/scanner scrape labels.

panels.title: Active workers
panels.description: Executions after lock acquisition, summed across selected scanner replicas.

panels.title: Completed executions
panels.description: Successful controller executions during the selected time range; retries/rescans count again.

panels.title: Failed executions
panels.description: Original execution failures, not the count of report polls returning an error.

panels.title: Since last success
panels.description: No observations until this process has completed a successful scan. Idle scanners need not have a recent success.

panels.title: Adapter and engine versions
panels.description: Actual binary versions; a missing engine version is unknown.

options.content:
Scanner operations for one selected installation. **Runtime includes the Trivy child workload.** Vulnerability findings remain in Harbor.

Empty selectors require `cluster`, `namespace`, and `scanner` labels. A reachable target with zero instrumented replicas needs an adapter with operational metrics. Optional infrastructure, cache size, Redis-server and Loki panels show no observations when their sources are unavailable. [Setup and metric semantics](https://github.com/container-registry/harbor-scanner-trivy/blob/main/deploy/chart/dashboards/README.md).

panels.title: Pod CPU
panels.description: Requires cAdvisor and matching cluster/namespace/pod labels. Includes child processes and any sidecars. No data is not zero usage.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) ((max by (cluster,namespace,pod,container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",container!="",container!="POD",image!=""}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (cluster,namespace,pod) max by (cluster,namespace,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}))

panels.title: Pod memory and limits
panels.description: Working set includes Trivy children; limits include all pod containers. Missing limits are not unlimited capacity measurements.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) ((max by (cluster,namespace,pod,container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",container!="",container!="POD",image!=""})) and on (cluster,namespace,pod) max by (cluster,namespace,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}))

sum by (pod) ((max by (cluster,namespace,pod,container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",resource="memory",unit="byte"})) and on (cluster,namespace,pod) max by (cluster,namespace,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}))

panels.title: CPU throttling
panels.description: Throttled scheduling periods / total periods. Requires cAdvisor.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) ((max by (cluster,namespace,pod,container) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",container!="",container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (cluster,namespace,pod) max by (cluster,namespace,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""})) / sum by (pod) ((max by (cluster,namespace,pod,container) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",container!="",container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (cluster,namespace,pod) max by (cluster,namespace,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}))

panels.title: Container restarts
panels.description: Restarts during the selected range, across selected scanner pod containers.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) ((max by (cluster,namespace,pod,container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}[$__range]))) and on (cluster,namespace,pod) max by (cluster,namespace,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}))

panels.title: Child peak RSS (p95)
panels.description: Completed child peak RSS. Not live memory, total concurrent-child memory or container peak. No sample if the adapter cannot observe termination.

panels.title: Last container termination was OOM
panels.description: Optional kube-state-metrics evidence of the last termination reason, not an OOM event counter.

targets.expr: max by (pod,container) ((kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",reason="OOMKilled"}) and on (cluster,namespace,pod) max by (cluster,namespace,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}))

panels.title: Execution throughput
panels.description: Terminal executions per second; multiple tasks and retries are separate observations.

panels.title: Execution latency (p95)
panels.description: Controller processing after lock acquisition, including persistence and recovered fallback. Successful and failed populations stay separate.

panels.title: Adapter queue wait (p95)
panels.description: Adapter enqueue to acquired lock; excludes Harbor scheduling. Old messages without timestamps are omitted.

panels.title: Worker utilization
panels.description: Per-replica active workers divided by configured capacity.

panels.title: Oldest running execution
panels.description: Zero while idle. Compare against the CLI timeout; the entire job can include preparation/fallback/persistence.

panels.title: Failure categories
panels.description: Primary execution failures. Child-output classification is heuristic; inspect logs for details.

panels.title: Dispatch outcomes
panels.description: Lock contention is a skipped duplicate delivery, not a failed scan. Decode/lock errors prevent execution.

panels.title: Trivy child duration (p95)
panels.description: Each image, SBOM or metadata/version child attempt. These are not Trivy-internal phase timings.

panels.title: SBOM reuse and fallback
panels.description: Lookup, reuse and fallback events can overlap within one job. Does not measure time saved.

panels.title: Publications with no subscribers
panels.description: Redis accepted these messages with no subscriber. Pub/Sub is not a durable queue.

panels.title: Child termination reasons
panels.description: A signal is not proof of OOM; use container termination evidence.

panels.title: Configured CLI timeout
panels.description: Configured CLI timeout; worker lock lifetime and total job duration are different concepts.

panels.title: Database age
panels.description: Content build age per database and replica. A newer replica must not hide an older one.

panels.title: Database presence
panels.description: 1 means file plus parseable metadata present, not DB integrity. Java DB may legitimately be absent until needed.

panels.title: Next database update
panels.description: Seconds until the advertised update time; negative means past that timestamp. Interpret with update policy.

panels.title: Automatic updates enabled
panels.description: 1 enables updates; 0 reflects the effective skip-update flag. Offline-scan alone does not disable DB downloads.

panels.title: Metadata collection status
panels.description: 1 means the latest version/metadata refresh succeeded. Missing DB is reported separately.

panels.title: Metadata snapshot age
panels.description: Age since last successful refresh, not since database publication.

panels.title: Local cache footprint
panels.description: Opt in with metrics.collection.cacheSizeEnabled. Logical file sizes for known local layout; unsupported, absent or over-budget collection is not zero.

panels.title: Filesystem utilization
panels.description: Cache and report paths can share a filesystem. Do not sum areas or replicas.

panels.title: Available filesystem space
panels.description: Space available to the scanner; cache growth can prevent report creation even with healthy probes.

panels.title: Available inodes
panels.description: Only where inode accounting is meaningful. A filesystem can run out of inodes before bytes.

panels.title: Estimated time to full
panels.description: Estimate from declining available space over six hours, with at least 60 samples. Resizes/cleanup/nonlinear growth affect it; no result without a decreasing trend.

panels.title: Storage collection status
panels.description: 1 means latest collection succeeded. Cache walks are optional; missing collector series can be disabled.

panels.title: Report size (p95)
panels.description: Matched raw/compressed report write observations. Compare sums, not percentiles, for compression ratio.

panels.title: Compression ratio
panels.description: Raw bytes divided by compressed bytes for matched applied report writes. Higher means greater compression.

panels.title: Applied payload write rate
panels.description: Confirmed job/report writes. Uncompressed equivalent and compressed payload are separate. This is not resident Redis memory.

panels.title: Report fetch outcomes
panels.description: Polls are independent of scan executions. Not found can mean expiry or unknown ID.

panels.title: Successful report fetch age (p95)
panels.description: Time since persisted completion for available reports. Not remaining TTL; missing reports have no age sample.

panels.title: Effective report retention TTL
panels.description: Refreshed by writes. Do not infer Redis memory from write rate × TTL.

panels.title: Store operation outcomes
panels.description: Includes failed, missing and unapplied operations; only applied writes count payload bytes.

panels.title: Store latency (p95)
panels.description: Logical store operation duration, including failures. Not Trivy analysis-cache access.

panels.title: Redis pool connections
panels.description: Total includes idle. Pool connection reuse is not an analysis-cache hit.

panels.title: Redis pool timeouts
panels.description: Pool wait timeouts; sustained timeouts can prevent progress.

panels.title: Average pool wait
panels.description: Accumulated waiting duration divided by number of waits; no observations when no waits occurred.

panels.title: Redis server memory (optional)
panels.description: Set Redis service to the actual exporter target service. Includes other users when Redis is shared; not attributable solely to scanner reports.

panels.title: API request rate
panels.description: Route templates only; probes and metrics scrapes are excluded.

panels.title: API latency (p95)
panels.description: HTTP request time, not scan duration.

panels.title: Adapter Go heap
panels.description: Adapter heap only; does not include the Trivy subprocess.

panels.title: Harbor scan queue size
panels.description: Harbor jobservice queue across the selected namespace. Not scoped to one scanner registration; shown as upstream context.

panels.title: Harbor scan queue latency
panels.description: Age of the next Harbor job. This is not adapter queue wait or CLI time.

panels.title: Harbor scan job outcomes
panels.description: Harbor-side outcomes for the installation. Includes orchestration/polling; may include other registered scanners.

panels.title: Scanner logs
panels.description: Requires Loki labels cluster, namespace and pod matching Prometheus discovery. Hidden scanner_pods expands only pods of the selected scanner. Redis/registry IDs are retained in log messages, not metric labels.

panels.title: Scanner errors
panels.description: Requires Loki labels cluster, namespace and pod matching Prometheus discovery. Hidden scanner_pods expands only pods of the selected scanner. Redis/registry IDs are retained in log messages, not metric labels.
